text: Attended the IBM Quantum Developer Conference 2026
Hosted and served as Lead Organizer for Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 at Clemson
Won 2nd place at DuQuantum 2026 at Duke with a calibration-⁠aware Dicke state preparation for Google’s Willow processor (Google Quantum AI challenge)
Competed at QHack 2026, PennyLane’s quantum computing hackathon
Became Director of SC Quantathon, after serving as Tech Lead for SC Quantathon v3
Became President of the Clemson Quantum Club, after two years as Vice President
Served as Tech Lead for SC Quantathon v3, leading technical planning and execution of the first Quantathon held at Clemson
Presented a poster on MEDA, our measurement-⁠efficient disorder-⁠aware Majorana zero mode detection framework, at Clemson HPC Day
Nathan Jones presented our MEDA paper at IEEE Quantum Week 2026 (QCE 2026) in Toronto, ON
Started my Ph.D. in Civil Engineering at Clemson University, researching quantum ML/AI, cybersecurity, and cyber-⁠physical systems in Dr. Chowdhury’s group
Our MEDA paper on measurement-⁠efficient disorder-⁠aware Majorana zero mode detection was accepted at IEEE Quantum Week 2026 (QCE 2026)
Graduated from Clemson University with a B.S. in Physics and a minor in Italian Studies
Won 3rd place at YQuantum 2026 at Yale for cat qubit control optimization with team (Ψ)ceratops
Won 1st place at iQuHack 2026 at MIT with a Reed–⁠Muller decoding-⁠based Clifford+T circuit optimizer (Superquantum challenge)
Selected as an IBM Qiskit Advocate
Hosted and served as Lead Organizer for Qiskit Fall Fest 2025 at Clemson
Competed at SC Quantathon v2, building quantum kernels for tornado prediction
Co-authored a paper on chiral phonons in layered AgCrP₂Se₆, published in ACS Nano
Started a summer internship in the Quantum AI group at Savannah River National Laboratory, implementing VQE for Kitaev chain Hamiltonians
Presented NeurotiQ at the NYUAD Quantum Hackathon in Abu Dhabi
Co-authored a talk on temperature-dependent Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy of AgBiP₂Se₆, presented by Thuc T. Mai at the APS Global Physics Summit 2025 in Anaheim, CA
Competed at iQuHack 2025 at MIT in the Alice & Bob challenge
Received a NISQ Quantum Grant from DoraHacks
Won 1st place and the Grand Prize Overall at the inaugural SC Quantathon for quantum random number generation on IBM hardware
Co-founded the Clemson Quantum Club
Started a summer internship in the Materials and Manufacturing Directorate at the Air Force Research Laboratory
Joined the Clemson Nanomaterials Institute as an Undergraduate Research Assistant
